description: This file contains helper functions and data structures for LDPC segmenter implementations within a communication system, including segment parameter definitions, length computations, and metadata generation.

methods.name: compute_rm_length
methods.description: Calculates the length of the rate-matched codeblock for a segment based on parameters, modulation, and layer count.

methods.name: generate_cb_metadata
methods.description: Generates codeblock metadata for a specific segment configuration.
